# TourYatras

> > TourYatras is a comprehensive travel guide platform featuring destination guides, seasonal travel recommendations, and curated experiences across India and beyond.

The site specializes in Indian tourism with a focus on hill stations, monsoon destinations, budget family travel, and solo traveler resources. Content includes detailed guides for Western Ghats locations like Khandala and Lonavala, adventure travel spots, and seasonal travel planning for spring and monsoon seasons.

## Key Topics

- Indian hill stations and Western Ghats destinations
- Monsoon travel and waterfall tourism
- Budget family destinations in India
- Solo female travel guides
- Seasonal travel (spring, monsoon)
- Khandala, Manali, Lonavala
- Adventure activities and trekking
- Duke's Nose, Tiger's Leap, Bhushi Dam
- Nature and scenic valleys
- Mumbai and Bangalore city guides
- West Bengal tourism
- Spring blooms and valley destinations
- Rajmachi Fort and heritage sites
- Beach destinations like Shrivardhan

## Seasonal Travel Guides

- [7 Beautiful Spots of Khandala That Must Visit This Monsoon](https://www.touryatras.com/web-stories/7-beautiful-spots-of-khandala-that-must-visit-this-monsoon): Monsoon travel guide featuring Khandala's Duke's Nose, Tiger's Leap & Bhushi Dam
- [5 Valleys That Look Unreal During This Spring](https://www.touryatras.com/web-stories/5-valleys-that-look-unreal-during-this-spring): Spring valley destinations: Yosemite, Kashmir, Lauterbrunnen & scenic spots

## Budget and Family Travel

- [10 Best Low Budget Family Destinations in India for May (2025)](https://www.touryatras.com/web-stories/10-best-low-budget-family-destinations-in-india-for-may): Budget family travel: Rishikesh, Manali & affordable May destinations in India

## Solo Travel Experiences

- [Solo Date in Bangalore for Female: Best Places & Ideas](https://www.touryatras.com/web-stories/solo-date-in-bangalore-for-female-best-places-ideas): Solo female travel guide for Bangalore: Cubbon Park, cafes & activities
